== Notes ==
* Brutal Strike is the highest damage dealing Pet Attack in PvE and the second highest in PvP (the first being [[Enraged Lunge (PvP)]]) when the conditional requirement is met. 

== Trivia ==
{{Skill change}}
* During early development, the skill icon for Brutal Strike was used for a skill called "Call of Ferocity"<ref>https://web.archive.org/web/20041030000940/http://www.gamespot.com/pc/rpg/guildwars/preview_6111324.html</ref>. It is unclear whether this skill had the same functionality as Brutal Strike or not.
